name: opum-workflow
description: The Opum fleet's shared workflow: the SDLC skill that governs task-before-branch delivery, session handover, the engineering and documentation skills the fleet reviews against, and four dispatchable subagents (implementer, reviewer, verifier, documenter) that each compile a Lore context pack before acting. The fleet's fifth Lore profile, orchestration, is not one of these four - it describes how a session's own top-level work uses the lore skill directly, not a role the Agent tool dispatches to. Use when working in an Opum repository, or as a worked example of a Quest-tracked, Lore-documented delivery loop.
